她挑起他的兴趣来了。黑眸望着离去的水蓝身影，眸底有抹火热。

裴璎珞刚踏出灵凤轩，即看到一辆马车停在门口，从马车上走下的人，令她讶异得杏眸圆睁。

「苏大哥，你怎么来了？」他此刻不是该在春日客栈陪悦儿的吗？

「悦儿被丫发急叫回去了。我听你提起想来看看灵凤轩，回去的路上就绕过来瞧瞧，好在正好遇上你，一起回去吧。」苏坤源伸手欲扶她上马车，身后�腥淮�来叫唤声。

「苏兄。」

苏坤源闻言，顿住脚步，旋身望去，在瞧见慕容彻一贯的笑脸后，斯文的脸上扬笑。

「慕容兄，又见面了。」

「苏兄和裴姑娘是何关系？看来似乎关系匪浅？一慕容彻挑明地问，目光却锁住背对着他的纤细身影。

「裴、苏两家是旧识，我和璎珞关系自是不同。」苏坤源笑容坦荡，没听出他话中之意。

「苏大哥，我累了，想早点回去休息。」裴璎珞却听出了他话中的含意，但不愿多想，催促他快离开。

「慕容兄，我们先告辞了。」苏坤源扶着她步上马车，坐进车厢里，马车随即离开。

「少主，若是我听到的传闻没错的话，裴二小姐是苏家老爷和夫人特意邀来家中作客，目的是要促成她和苏坤源之间的婚事。」常青想起前不久所听到的传闻。

「是吗？」慕容彻勾唇一笑，黑眸微敛，旋身步入铺子里。

见状，常青和韦翰互视一眼，韦翰立即跟上。

常青望着远去的马车，还有踏进铺子里的少主。若是他没猜错的话，少主该是对裴二小姐上了心；但少主的心思向来难测，还是别多事的好，忙不迭地跟着踏进铺子里。

「二小姐，没想到我们会再次遇上在朱雀城胡同里那个可怕的男人，更没想到他竟是大少爷想要合作的对象。」

秋月一脸畏惧，一面看着正绘着发簪样式的二小姐，一面忍不住碎念着。

这个二小姐会不会太尽责了，出门到别人府上作客，还不忘大少爷所交代的工作。

「慕容彻这人太过深沉，如非必要，我不想再与此人见面。」裴璎珞将画好的发簪图稿小心地吹干上头的颜料，脑海中同时浮起慕容彻的笑脸来。

「二小姐，我们来苏府也有三天了，你打算什么时候向苏夫人开口你对苏少爷无意的事？我们也好早日返回青龙城。」

慕容彻既无意与珠玉阁合作，而二小姐留在苏府也只是为他人作嫁，若是事情早日处理完，她们也好尽早回去。

「再过几天吧。一她答应助悦儿和苏大哥一臂之力，总不能连忙都还没帮成就走人吧。

叩叩。房门外在此时传来叩门声，秋月走上前开门，外头站着一名丫鬟。

「方才有人送来一封信，说是要给裴姑娘的。」丫鬟将信交给秋月便离开了。

「二小姐，你的信。」秋月将信交给裴璎珞，好奇地站在她身旁。

裴璎珞疑惑地黛眉微挑，接过信后，立即拆开来。

「原来是悦儿写给我的。信中她提到她爹要将她许给别人，约我马上到春日客栈一趟。」裴璎珞看完信后，柔美小脸浮现担忧，这下事情可棘手了。

「二小姐，那现在该怎么办？」秋月也不免替上官悦着急起来。

「我们马上去一趟春日客栈，途中先绕去米行找苏大哥一同前去。」裴璎珞话尾刚落，倏地起身，疾步走出房。

当裴璎珞和苏坤源赶到春日客栈时，已是半个时辰后的事了。

两人一同踏入包厢内，早已在里头等候的上官悦见着两人，眼泪忍不住落了下来。

「悦儿。」苏坤源忙不迭地上前拥抱住她，心疼不舍地替她拭去脸上的泪水。

「悦儿，你爹打算将你许给谁呢？」裴璎珞见她哭成泪人儿…心底十分不舍。

「爹看上灵凤轩的主子慕容彻，已多次上门主动提及婚事，这事是娘偷偷告诉我的。」上官悦哽咽说完，忍不住又哭了起来。

闻言，苏坤源和裴璎珞两人脸上皆露出惊愕，尤其是裴璎珞，更是忍不住在心底叹息。她才刚说过还是少见慕容彻为妙，没想到这会儿看来，两人可能很快又要见面了。

「慕容兄同意了吗？」苏坤源紧张地问。

「我不知道。我只知道爹今日又上灵凤轩去了，只要慕容彻点头，爹马上筹备婚事。」娘趁着爹踏出门，就要她立即去找坤源哥商量对策。

「你们在这等我，我这就去一趟灵凤轩找慕容兄谈谈。」苏坤源话一说完，将上官悦交给裴璎珞照顾，随即大步踏出包厢。

「坤源哥……」上官悦阻止不及，只能眼睁睁看着他离开。「璎珞，坤源哥就这样去找慕容彻会不会有事呢？」上官悦担忧地望着好友。

「应该不会。这事由苏大哥出面处理较为妥当，我们就在这等等看吧。」裴璎珞一时也想不出什么好主意来。

两人怀着忐忑不安的心情等候，而这一等，就等了一个半时辰，才见苏坤源一脸凝重地踏进包厢。

「坤源哥，你去谈得怎么样了？」上官悦见着他，立即扑进他怀里，拉着他的手急问。

「慕容兄说这桩婚事他尚未答应，但他会认真考虑。」苏坤源想到和慕容彻的对话，懊恼自己无法说服他放弃。

「苏大哥，你可有见到悦儿她爹？」裴璎珞问。

「我去的时候等了半个时辰，那时悦儿她爹正在和慕容兄谈婚事。」苏坤源一脸颓丧。

「苏大哥，你是否可以告诉我和慕容公子谈话的内容？」裴璎珞走到他面前，轻问。

「我对慕容兄提及与悦儿两情相悦的事，近日会说服爹娘同意我们的婚事，请他千万别答应悦儿她爹所提的婚事。」

「那慕容公子如何回答？」

「他说原以为我和你在一起，和悦儿的婚事，他近日会有明确的回覆，却始终不肯给我一个肯定的答覆。」提起这件事，苏坤源就发愁的不知该如何是好。

裴璎珞沉吟了会，杏眸望向上官悦。「悦儿，你可曾见过慕容公子？」

「没有，我从未见过他。就算去灵凤轩观赏水晶，也从没遇上过他。」上官悦如实回答。

所以她真的不明白为何慕容彻会对她这个从未见过面之人，且在明白她已心有所属后，还要考虑这桩婚事。

裴璎珞这一听，柔美小脸上有抹沉凝。虽然她并非十分了解慕容彻这个人，但几次接触下来，她相信他并非是个容易受人摆布之人，相反的，做事该是十分有计划、谨慎才对。

就算慕容彻曾见过悦儿，但两人从未相处过，他又怎能确定自己喜欢悦儿呢？他并非是个看重美貌之人，可他却不肯干脆回答苏大哥，如今的犹豫只说明了一件事——他在计划着什么事吗？

「坤源哥，现在该怎么办才好？」上官悦急得眼泪落了下来。如果要她嫁给一个她不爱的人，她宁死不从。

苏坤源一脸忧愁，轻搂着她，在她耳边承诺：

「明日我会再去一趟灵凤轩，就算是用跪求的，也一定要求得慕容兄答应成全我们。」

裴璎珞看着两人，心下另有主意，眼看时候不早了，三人实在不宜在这久留。

「时候不早，我们该离开了。悦儿你回去时小心一点，千万别被人发现，这事我们明日再做讨论。」

「也对。悦儿，你爹已回府了，你快回去吧。别担心，一切有我。」苏坤源轻搂着她安抚，陪着她走出包厢。

三人一同走出春日客栈，在上官悦先行离开后，苏坤源欲步上马车时，裴璎珞柔声开口：

「苏大哥，我还有些东西想买，晚一点再回去，你先走吧。」
content_en:
She had piqued his interest.His black eyes looked at the departing aqua figure, with a hint of fire in his eyes.

As soon as Pei Yingluo stepped out of Lingfengxuan, she saw a carriage parked at the door. The people getting off the carriage made her eyes widen in surprise.

"Brother Su, why are you here?" Shouldn't he be accompanying Yue'er at the Spring Inn at this moment?

"Yue'er was called back by Yafa in a hurry. I heard you mentioned that you wanted to come and see Lingfengxuan, so I stopped by to have a look on the way back. Fortunately, I happened to meet you. Let's go back together." Su Kunyuan stretched out his hand to help her get on the carriage, when a voice came from behind.

"Brother Su."

When Su Kunyuan heard this, he stopped and turned to look around. After seeing Murong Che's usual smiling face, a gentle smile spread across his face.

"Brother Murong, we meet again."

"What is the relationship between Brother Su and Miss Pei? It seems that they have a close relationship?" Murong Che asked pointedly, but his eyes were locked on the slender figure with her back to him.

"The Pei and Su families are old acquaintances, but Yingluo and I have a different relationship." Su Kunyuan smiled openly and did not understand the meaning of his words.

"Brother Su, I'm tired and want to go back and rest early." Pei Yingluo heard the meaning of his words, but she didn't want to think too much and urged him to leave quickly.

"Brother Murong, let's say goodbye first." Su Kunyuan helped her step onto the carriage, got into the carriage, and the carriage left immediately.

"Young Master, if the rumors I heard are correct, Miss Pei Er was specially invited to our home by Mr. and Mrs. Su family to facilitate the marriage between her and Su Kunyuan." Chang Qing thought of the rumors he heard not long ago.

"Really?" Murong Che raised his lips and smiled, narrowed his dark eyes, and walked into the shop.

Seeing this, Chang Qing and Wickham looked at each other, and Wickham immediately followed.

Chang Qing looked at the carriage going away and the young master who stepped into the shop.If he guessed correctly, the young master should have fallen in love with Miss Pei Er; but the young master's thoughts were always unpredictable, so it was better to stay out of trouble and follow her into the shop hurriedly.

"Second Miss, I didn't expect that we would meet that scary man in the alley of Suzaku City again, and we didn't expect that he would be the one that the young master wants to cooperate with."

Qiuyue had a look of fear on her face, while looking at the second lady who was painting a hairpin style, she couldn't help but think about it.

Could it be that this second young lady is too conscientious, going out to visit other people's houses, and not forgetting the work assigned by the young master?

"Murong Che is too deep. I don't want to meet this person again unless necessary." Pei Yingluo carefully dried the paint on the hairpin drawing, while Murong Che's smiling face appeared in her mind.

"Second Miss, we have been in the Su Mansion for three days. When are you going to tell Mrs. Su about your unintentional affair with Master Su? We can also return to Qinglong City as soon as possible."

Murong Che had no intention of cooperating with Zhuyu Pavilion, and the second young lady stayed in the Su Mansion only to marry others. If the matter was settled as soon as possible, they would go back as soon as possible.

"It'll take a few days. Once she agrees to help Yue'er and Brother Su, she can't leave without helping Yue'er.

Knock knock.There was a knock on the door at this moment. Qiuyue stepped forward and opened the door. There was a maid standing outside.

"Someone just sent a letter, saying it was for Miss Pei." The maid handed the letter to Qiuyue and left.

"Second Miss, your letter." Qiuyue handed the letter to Pei Yingluo and stood beside her curiously.

Pei Yingluo raised her eyebrows slightly in confusion. After receiving the letter, she immediately opened it.

"It turned out to be Yue'er who wrote to me. In the letter, she mentioned that her father was going to marry her to someone else and asked me to come to the Spring Inn immediately." After Pei Yingluo read the letter, worry appeared on her beautiful face. Now things were getting tricky.

"Second Miss, what should we do now?" Qiuyue couldn't help but become worried for Shangguan Yue.

"We're going to the Spring Inn right away. On the way, we'll go to Mihang to meet Brother Su." Pei Yingluo just finished her words, stood up quickly, and walked out of the room quickly.

When Pei Yingluo and Su Kunyuan arrived at the Spring Inn, it was already half an hour later.

The two of them stepped into the box together. Shangguan Yue, who had been waiting inside, couldn't help but shed tears when he saw the two of them.

"Yue'er." Su Kunyuan hurriedly stepped forward to hug her, and wiped away the tears on her face with distress.

"Yue'er, who is your father planning to marry you to?" Pei Yingluo saw her burst into tears... feeling very reluctant to give up.

"Dad has taken a liking to Murong Che, the master of Lingfengxuan, and has come to his door many times to mention the marriage. Mom secretly told me about this." Shangguan Yue choked up and couldn't help crying again.

Hearing this, both Su Kunyuan and Pei Yingluo showed shock on their faces, especially Pei Yingluo, who couldn't help but sigh in her heart.She had just said that it would be better to see Murong Che less often, but now it seemed that the two of them might meet again soon.

"Brother Murong, have you agreed?" Su Kunyuan asked nervously.

"I don't know. I only know that dad went to Lingfengxuan again today. As long as Murong Che nods, dad will immediately prepare for the wedding." While dad stepped out, her mother asked her to go to Brother Kunyuan immediately to discuss countermeasures.

"You guys wait for me here. I'm going to Lingfengxuan to talk to Brother Murong." As soon as Su Kunyuan finished speaking, he handed Shangguan Yue to Pei Yingluo's care, and then strode out of the box.

"Brother Kunyuan..." Shangguan Yue couldn't stop him in time and could only watch him leave."Yingluo, will it be okay if Brother Kunyuan goes to find Murong Che like this?" Shangguan Yue looked at his friend worriedly.

"Probably not. It would be more appropriate for Brother Su to handle this matter. Let's just wait and see." Pei Yingluo couldn't think of any good ideas for the moment.

The two of them waited with uneasiness, and they waited for an hour and a half before they saw Su Kunyuan step into the box with a solemn look on his face.

"Brother Kunyuan, how was your talk?" Shangguan Yue saw him and immediately threw herself into his arms, holding his hand and asking urgently.

"Brother Murong said that he has not agreed to the marriage yet, but he will seriously consider it." Su Kunyuan thought of the conversation with Murong Che and regretted that he could not persuade him to give up.

"Brother Su, have you met Yue'er's father?" Pei Yingluo asked.

"I waited for half an hour when I went there. At that time, Yue'er's father was discussing marriage with Brother Murong." Su Kunyuan looked dejected.

"Brother Su, can you tell me the content of the conversation with Mr. Murong?" Pei Yingluo walked up to him and asked lightly.

"I mentioned to Brother Murong that I am in love with Yue'er. I will persuade my parents to agree to our marriage in the near future. Please never agree to the marriage proposed by Yue'er's father."

"Then how will Mr. Murong answer?"

"He said that he thought he would have a clear answer about my marriage with you and Yue'er in the near future, but he still refused to give me a definite answer." When this matter was mentioned, Su Kunyuan was worried and didn't know what to do.

Pei Yingluo pondered for a while and looked at Shangguan Yue with her almond-shaped eyes."Yue'er, have you ever met Mr. Murong?"

"No, I have never seen him. Even if I went to Lingfengxuan to view crystals, I have never met him." Shangguan Yue answered truthfully.

So she really didn't understand why Murong Che would consider this marriage to someone she had never met before, and after knowing that she already had a crush on him.

Upon hearing this, Pei Yingluo's soft little face became condensed.Although she didn't know Murong Che very well, after several contacts with him, she believed that he was not someone who was easily manipulated by others. On the contrary, he should be very planned and cautious in doing things.

Even if Murong Che had met Yue'er before, but the two had never gotten along, how could he be sure that he liked Yue'er?He is not a person who values ​​beauty, but he refuses to answer Brother Su directly. His hesitation now only shows one thing - is he planning something?

"Brother Kunyuan, what should we do now?" Shangguan Yue was so anxious that tears fell down.If she was asked to marry someone she didn't love, she would rather die than do it.

Su Kunyuan looked sad, hugged her gently, and promised in her ear:

"Tomorrow I will go to Lingfeng Pavilion again. Even if I beg on my knees, I will definitely ask Brother Murong to agree to help us."

Pei Yingluo looked at the two of them and had another idea in mind. Seeing that it was getting late, the three of them really shouldn't stay here for a long time.

"It's getting late, we should leave. Yue'er, be careful when you go back, don't be discovered. We'll discuss this matter tomorrow."

"That's right. Yue'er, your father has returned home. You should go back quickly. Don't worry, I will take care of everything." Su Kunyuan hugged her gently to comfort her and accompanied her out of the box.

The three of them walked out of the Spring Inn together. After Shangguan Yue left first, and when Su Kunyuan was about to get on the carriage, Pei Yingluo spoke softly:

"Brother Su, I still have some things I want to buy. I'll go back later. You can go first."
